diagnoses.analysis: This aggregate job fails because the lint dependency failed, not because of an independent build problem. The frozen log executes exit 1; .github/workflows/reusable-pr-build.yml:62-89 requires needs.lint.result to be success for this non-release PR. All other frozen checks passed. The shared fix adds the missing Markdown list separator in changelog.d/20376.breaking.2.md; no workflow change is needed.

The new runtime telemetry fragment starts a list immediately after its introductory paragraph, violating rumdl MD032. Applied the exact CI version rumdl 0.3.0 to this file, adding only one blank line. The same version and repository configuration then passed for all 78 added or modified Markdown files relative to the frozen merge base. All migration text is unchanged.
evidence: changelog.d/20376.breaking.2.md:2:1: [MD032] List should be preceded by blank line [*]

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

metadata.body:
Now with AI, I think adding change log entries no longer poses much of a burden on contributors.

And this will allow AI code review to incrementally review each change log entry over time (we will need to improve our code review guidelines for change log entries).

And it will avoid merge conflicts.
